summary_en: Japanetholder announced intention to launch tender offer for Twinbird common shares. Twinbird board has not endorsed or opposed; special committee established to evaluate whether transaction enhances enterprise value and shareholder interest. Board position to follow. Terms (price, timeline, shareholding threshold) not yet disclosed by target.
title_en: Notice Regarding Planned Commencement of Open Tender Offer for Our Shares by Japanetholder Inc.
translation_en_brief: Japanetholder Inc. announced on 19 June 2026 its intention to launch an open tender offer for all common shares of Twinbird Corporation (ticker 6897, Tokyo Standard). Twinbird received the initial proposal from Japanetholder on 11 May 2026. Twinbird established a special committee composed of independent external directors to evaluate the proposal. The target company requested Japanetholder refrain from public announcement until the board's fair-process review was complete, but Japanetholder proceeded with announcement unilaterally and without prior agreement with Twinbird. Twinbird stated it will scrutinize Japanetholder's announcement and conduct careful deliberation through its board and special committee to determine whether the transaction enhances enterprise value and shareholder interest. Twinbird noted Japanetholder's statement was not pre-cleared and may contain inaccuracies. The target's board position will be disclosed separately. The specific tender price, share count target, and timeline have not been disclosed in this filing and will depend on Japanetholder's formal offer document.
